title: Getting started with Downgrading Your Plan

question.author: member_029
question.body: I am setting up CloudBox and want to understand downgrading your plan. What does the current documentation say?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: When you downgrade to a plan with less storage, CloudBox never deletes your data immediately. Files above the new quota become read-only/download-only for 90 days, and new uploads are blocked. Shared links to over-quota content remain live during those 90 days but only allow viewing and downloading — no uploads through links. After 90 days, over-quota files are moved to the recycle bin and those shared links expire. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
